headline: QA-focused brief: agent evaluation, agent observability, edge test harnesses, and infra hygiene

top_signal.title: How to evaluate AI agents from tool calls to task completion
top_signal.summary: NVIDIA outlines an agent evaluation framework that scores both step-level (process) traces and end-to-end outcome checks using executable environments, offering concrete metrics (success rate, consistency, tool-call precision, argument accuracy, steps, cost).
top_signal.why_it_matters: Provides a practical, debuggable evaluation stack for QA teams validating agentic test automation and LLM-driven tooling against live stateful environments.

items.title: OpenTelemetry support added to the GitHub Copilot app
items.summary: GitHub Copilot app now lets enterprises export agent traces via OpenTelemetry, with enterprise-managed telemetry configuration and prompt/response capture off by default.
items.why_it_matters: Enables QA teams to ingest agent session traces into existing observability pipelines to triage agent failures, reproduce multi-step runs, and audit tool calls.

items.title: Copilot for JetBrains adds AI-assisted tool approvals and plan-mode
items.summary: Copilot for JetBrains 1.18.0 introduces assisted approvals for low-risk tool calls, plan-review (Codex agent plan mode), persistent per-tool controls, and shared organization skills/instructions.
items.why_it_matters: Gives QA leads policy and review controls for agent-driven code edits and tool usage, reducing unsafe automation while enabling repeatable, reviewable agent test flows.

items.title: Python Workers generally available on Cloudflare (native Python + AI orchestration)
items.category: Edge test harnesses / Agent execution environments
items.summary: Cloudflare announced GA for Python Workers, enabling Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries to run natively in the Workers runtime (integrations with R2, D1, Workers AI).
items.why_it_matters: QA teams can run agentic harnesses and lightweight executable test environments at the edge, making domain-specific, low-latency agent evaluations and in-situ integration tests feasible.

items.title: Worker Previews: isolated preview environments for agent-driven changes
items.summary: Cloudflare Worker Previews provides an isolated URL, state, configuration, and observability per branch or change an agent makes, enabling parallel preview environments without touching production.
items.why_it_matters: Simplifies safe, parallel testing of agent-made changes and gives QA reproducible preview instances for verification, exploratory test runs, and automated regression checks before deployment.

learning.title: Kubernetes v1.37: PersistentVolumeClaim 'Unused' condition (PVC last-used time, Beta)
learning.summary: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes PersistentVolumeClaimUnusedSinceTime to Beta (enabled by default) and adds an `Unused` condition and lastTransitionTime to PVC status, making it easy to detect orphaned volumes without custom tooling.
learning.why_it_matters: Test infra owners can reliably find and automate cleanup of PVCs leaked by test jobs, reducing noisy resource exhaustion and flaky failures in shared CI/test clusters.
